correctionSummary.source: Allow legacy Soulseek clients to connect via bridge
correctionSummary.candidateTarget: Permita que clientes legados do Soulseek se conectem por meio de uma ponte.
correctionSummary.rationale: “Herdados” reads as inherited clients in this context; “legados” is the established software sense of legacy and preserves the Soulseek bridge permission.

correctionSummary.source: Allow legacy Soulseek clients to connect via bridge
correctionSummary.candidateTarget: Cho phép các máy khách Soulseek đời cũ kết nối thông qua cầu nối.
correctionSummary.rationale: “Kế thừa” means inherited and is a false friend for legacy here; “đời cũ” identifies older legacy clients while preserving Soulseek and bridge access.
“出生” means birth and misstates provenance. “來源” conveys the source/provenance label and keeps both runtime placeholders unchanged.

correctionSummary.source: Enable Lidarr replace existing files setting
correctionSummary.candidateTarget: Aktivieren Sie die Lidarr-Einstellung zum Ersetzen vorhandener Dateien.
correctionSummary.rationale: The current word order makes “Einstellung Lidarr” ungrammatical. The proposal clearly labels the Lidarr setting that enables replacement of existing files.

correctionSummary.source: Enable Lidarr replace existing files setting
correctionSummary.candidateTarget: Active la opción de Lidarr para reemplazar los archivos existentes.
correctionSummary.rationale: The current wording says Lidarr would replace the configuration of existing files. The proposal makes the checkbox option the thing being enabled and preserves the file-replacement meaning.

correctionSummary.source: Enable Lidarr replace existing files setting

correctionSummary.source: Enable Lidarr replace existing files setting

correctionSummary.source: Enable Lidarr replace existing files setting

correctionSummary.rationale: The current noun chain is awkward and leaves the setting relationship unclear. The proposal directly labels the Lidarr option to replace existing files.

correctionSummary.source: Enable Lidarr replace existing files setting
